source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Bulk Insert' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Bulk_Insert_Task_0') AS Bulk_Insert_Task_0_sink_FilePath;
